description: This file implements a ProseMirror plugin for table column resizing, including handling resize handles, drag events, and updating column widths within a rich text editor.

methods.name: columnResizing
methods.description: Creates a ProseMirror plugin for table column resizing with configurable options.

methods.name: createResizeState
methods.description: Generates and updates the resize state, including decorations and dragging status, based on transactions.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse or touch events to initiate column resize dragging, updating plugin state accordingly.

methods.name: currentColWidth
methods.description: Calculates the current width of a table column based on cell attributes and DOM measurements.

methods.name: edgeCell
methods.description: Finds the position of the left or right edge cell relative to a given position in the table.

methods.name: draggedWidth
methods.description: Calculates the new width of a column during dragging based on the initial drag state and current pointer position.

methods.name: updateColumnWidth
methods.description: Updates the column width attributes in the table node for all affected cells.

methods.name: displayColumnWidth
methods.description: Updates the visual display of a column's width in the DOM.

methods.name: zeroes
methods.description: Creates an array of zeros of specified length.

methods.name: createColumnResizeHandles
methods.description: Creates visual resize handle decorations for table cells.

methods.name: createResizeHandle
methods.description: Creates a DOM element representing a resize handle.
